name: Hunting Ground Middle of the Forest I
source: maplestory.io /api/GMS/8/map/1000005 (local copy docs/research/raw/gms_v8/1000005.json); geometry identical in gms_v22
conventions: MapleStory px, y grows DOWNWARD. Tier ids T0.. sorted top-to-bottom (T0 = highest). Ladder from_tier = tier at the BOTTOM end, to_tier = tier at the TOP end (null = no foothold there). kind: ground = attached to map bottom; ledge = raised block standing on ground or an object top; floating = free platform; slope = sloped ground piece.

layering.ground: T36 y215 | T34 mound y155 | T37 y215 | T35 y155 | T33 y95 (+ door block T29 top y5 on the mound)
layering.jump_tower: central zig-zag column of 168-px stones x-219..219 rising in 60-px steps from T27 y-145 to T9 y-745 (T27,T26,T25,T23,T21,T20,T18,T15,T13,T12,T11,T9 + T10 side shelf)
layering.left_stack: T32 y95, T30 y35, T28 y-25 then rope to T22 y-265

tiers.note: object foothold: one 117-px layer-0 foothold with a 3-px tilt and no walls. It is the top of a stacked log pile (raw WZ obj grassySoil/artificiality/6 at x886) standing on T16, about 31 px tall.
object foothold: top of a stacked log pile (obj artificiality/6 at x514) standing on T19, about 29 px tall
raised earth block (layer 0) standing on T34: walls x=6 and x=264 run from y5 down to y150, so it is 150 px tall. The exit door object is at x129 on its front face.
object foothold: top of a stacked log pile (obj artificiality/6 at x1014) standing on T33, about 27 px tall
east raised ground (dead-end corner, log pile)
central raised ground mound (60 px above T36/T37); spawn points and exit out00 here
links: riser 60px DOWN east to T37 at x=309
riser 60px UP east to T33 at x=771
riser 60px UP east to T34 at x=-219

tiers.note: low ground between mound and east steps; rainbow fountain
links: riser 60px UP east to T35 at x=681

terrain_style: Tile set tS=grassySoil (raw WZ <layer>/info/tS). Grass-topped earth: thick bright-green grass fringe over olive-brown mossy cobbled dirt with embedded grey boulders; floating platforms have ragged dirt undersides; ground blocks are solid dirt down to the map bottom (v8 render). Background set bS=grassySoil: tiled blue sky (no.0), drifting white cumulus clouds (no.1, type 4 = horizontal scroll), a distant domed grassy hill (no.2), a single big leafy tree (no.3), and a horizontally tiled meadow strip with golden grass (no.4) with the strongest parallax (raw WZ back/<n>; sprites viewed at Data/Map/Back/grassySoil.img/back/<no>).
